name: Simple Status Mod
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: LukevonErden
description: Simple Status Mod is a lightweight server-side Minecraft mod that lets players set custom statuses displayed in chat, the tab list, and in front of their nametag.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-27 (90fcc9da) (41 classes, 67 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
